headline: OpenAI announces joint vulnerability testing with Hacktron focused on third-party integrations
summary: On 6 November 2026, OpenAI announced a partnership with Hacktron to test vulnerabilities in OpenAI systems, focusing on interactions with third-party services. OpenAI said it would expand Hacktron’s access to frontier models through Daybreak Red. The announcement presents a security-program change, not a completed evaluation: it reports no joint findings, patches, independently confirmed results or measured impact.
